name: Classroom Quick Downloader
description: The fastest way to download all Google Classroom materials, assignments, and PDFs in one click.

scripts.test:coverage:all: pnpm run test:coverage:critical && pnpm run test:coverage:runtime
scripts.test:fuzz: vitest run tests/classroom-link-fuzz.test.ts tests/xss-prevention.test.ts tests/content-url-utils.test.ts tests/download-validator.test.ts
scripts.test:golden: pnpm run test:regression && pnpm run test:fuzz && pnpm run test:stress && pnpm run test:visual
scripts.edge: wxt build -b edge && wxt zip -b edge
scripts.firefox: wxt build -b firefox && wxt zip -b firefox
scripts.chrome: wxt build -b chrome && wxt zip -b chrome
scripts.safari: node -e "console.error('Safari support is temporarily disabled.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.safari:xcode: node -e "console.error('Safari support is temporarily disabled.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.safari:local: node -e "console.error('Safari support is temporarily disabled.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.build:all: wxt build -b chrome && wxt build -b firefox && wxt build -b edge
scripts.zip:all: wxt zip -b chrome && wxt zip -b firefox && wxt zip -b edge
